settings.ai.body: The jobs Daoris may use a model for. Each does its part with none, and says which tier answered.
settings.ai.search.label: Search and convergence
settings.ai.search.hint: The service reads `DAORIS_EMBED_MODEL` (a model's name), `DAORIS_EMBED_URL` (its endpoint; Ollama's local address unless set) and `DAORIS_EMBED_WINDOW` (the most characters embedded as one vector, 2,000 unless set; a longer entry is embedded in pieces) from its environment when it starts, so a change takes a restart of the service.
settings.ai.search.why: With no model, search matches words and convergence finds copies and restatements; both still answer, and say which tier did. A model adds what comparing text cannot: two repositories that reached the same conclusion in different words. Which model is the deployment's choice, never the feature's.
settings.ai.helper.why: A conversation about Daoris itself: how to set up a workspace, what a screen means, how to drive a repository or write a rule. It runs in a room of its own, reads, and proposes changes through the same doors this screen uses; nothing applies until you press Apply. With no agent named, it offers starters from what this machine lacks.
settings.ai.helper.tierOff: Ask Daoris offers starters from what this machine lacks, each a door to the screen that fixes it.
settings.ai.helper.tierOn: Ask Daoris runs on {{agent}}: it reads and proposes, and every change is yours to apply.
settings.ai.helper.tierOnFull: Ask Daoris runs on {{agent}} with full access: it acts on this machine itself, without Apply.
settings.ai.helpMode.label: Ask Daoris’s access
settings.ai.helpMode.hint: This machine’s choice, for every workspace. Also `daoris-driver help mode restricted|full`.
settings.ai.helpMode.why: Restricted, Ask Daoris reads and proposes, and every change waits for your Apply. With full access it runs commands, edits files and uses every installed plugin server itself, with no Apply and no routine permission approval: what it does there is its own act, not a proposal. A choice takes each conversation’s next turn.
settings.ai.helpMode.tierRestricted: Restricted: Ask Daoris reads and proposes, and every change is yours to apply.
settings.ai.helpMode.tierFull: Full access: Ask Daoris acts on this machine itself, without Apply.
settings.ai.helpMode.full: Ask Daoris runs with full access from each conversation’s next turn.
settings.ai.helpMode.restricted: Ask Daoris runs restricted from each conversation’s next turn.
settings.ai.grants.granted: Granted: {{operation}}. Ask Daoris has it from each conversation’s next turn.
settings.ai.grants.revoked: Taken back: {{operation}}. Ask Daoris’s next use of it is refused.
settings.ai.grants.notYet: Not available yet: nothing was chosen, and Ask Daoris is given nothing for it.
settings.ai.intake.why: An ask names no repository. The workspace's declarations answer it first, with no model, and what they leave is proposed to you. With an agent named here, those asks open a session on it instead: it reads the declarations, publishes the quests, and asks you where it cannot tell. Every intake spends a real account.
settings.ai.intake.tierOff: Asks are answered from the workspace's declarations; what they leave is proposed to you.
settings.ai.intake.tierOn: Declarations first; an ask they leave opens a session on {{agent}} — each one spends an account.
settings.ai.actors.fencedRule: models for the agents a rule names: {{state}}
settings.ai.actors.fencedAsk: models for the agent an ask names: {{state}}
settings.ai.actors.unreadable: Its entry in driver.json does not read, so it starts nothing: {{error}}
settings.ai.actors.later: Choice 2 runs only when no account of choice 1 can: cooling, signed out, or refusing its model.
settings.ai.actors.outranks: A model named here outranks the account's own and a repository's own setting.
settings.ai.actors.neverMoves: Running work never moves to another choice.
settings.ai.actors.goesOn: A conversation whose agent has no account left goes on with your next choice, handed Daoris's brief of it and your waiting words; one on your pick waits.
settings.ai.actors.most: At most {{count}} choices. Clear order takes it back to as before: the agent settings below, at account default.
settings.ai.actors.footnote: Also `daoris driver actor`. An older Daoris uses its own agent settings and rules, with no models.
settings.ai.actors.found.title: Changed outside Daoris
settings.ai.actors.found.body: Another program or an older Daoris changed these in driver.json. Daoris keeps running the roles above until you take a change; a change that turned something off was applied at once.
settings.ai.actors.found.taken: Taken: the roles are as that change set them.
settings.ai.actors.found.dismissed: Dismissed: the roles stay as they are.
settings.ai.actors.saved: {{actor}}'s order is saved; new work takes it.
settings.ai.roles.title: Roles
settings.ai.roles.moved: Working roles are set in Agents, under Roles.
settings.ai.roles.body: Each role takes one kind of work in one place: this machine, a workspace or a repository. A start takes the role of its most specific place and runs on the first of its choices that can run, in your order, saying so when it took a later one; Brainstorm runs all its choices at once. A work no role takes waits until you give it one; running work goes on.
settings.ai.roles.unkept: This home's driver.json is the file's own, so a role cannot be added, removed or moved to another place here; each role's order is still set.
settings.ai.roles.notOffered: Not offered by this shell: it keeps one order of choices for each role, set below, and no catalogue.
settings.ai.roles.readFailed: The roles could not be read, so the catalogue is not shown; try again in a moment.
settings.ai.roles.removed: Removed: its work waits until a role takes it.
settings.ai.roles.unreadable: Its record does not read, so the work it takes waits: {{error}}
settings.ai.roles.all.title: All roles
settings.ai.roles.fixedPlace: Placed {{place}}; the place is fixed and the id is made for you.
settings.ai.roles.removeFallback: {{role}} goes, and {{work}} falls back to {{fallback}}, placed {{place}}.
settings.ai.roles.removeNone: {{role}} goes, and {{work}} waits until a role takes it; running work goes on.
settings.ai.roles.field.name: Name
settings.ai.roles.field.takesAll: It takes {{works}}; one edit covers them all.
settings.ai.roles.editor.then: Saving puts this role to work at once: new work takes its choices, and running work keeps its own.
settings.ai.roles.choicesNote: Its choices run in order. Off is for the roles that take intake or Ask Daoris only. Restore role defaults gives a seeded role back its names, work and place; Clear staffing puts its choices back to as before.
settings.ai.roles.use.kept: Over the {{count}} day the log holds
settings.ai.roles.use.kept_other: Over the {{count}} days the log holds
settings.ai.roles.suggested.title: Suggested: {{role}}
settings.ai.roles.suggested.body: {{work}} runs on Build's choices while no role takes it. {{role}} would take it on {{choice}}, which can spend more than Build's.
settings.ai.roles.suggestedChoices.title: Suggested choices for your roles
settings.ai.roles.suggestedChoices.body: Daoris suggests these models for new work on this machine, read from its reference of {{date}}. Using them changes which models your accounts spend on, and can spend more than your roles use now. Anything already running keeps its choices, and nothing is applied until you press.
settings.ai.roles.suggestedChoices.left: Left out, not set up on this machine: {{agents}}.
settings.ai.roles.saved: {{role}} is saved; new work takes it.
settings.ai.roles.savedAll: Saved together: {{roles}}; new work takes them.
settings.ai.roles.removedSaved: {{role}} is removed; its work waits until a role takes it.
settings.ai.roles.defaultedAll: Every seeded role is the default again; the roles you added are kept.
settings.ai.roles.footnote: Also `daoris driver role`. An older Daoris runs the default roles and none you add.
settings.ai.policy.later: Choices take new work by their weights; a choice that cannot run passes to the next by weight.
settings.ai.policy.choicesNote: Its choices take new work by their weights. Off is for the roles that take intake or Ask Daoris only. Restore role defaults gives a seeded role back its names, work and place; Clear staffing puts its choices back to as before.
settings.ai.policy.lighter: Put the lighter choice first; Daoris knows no prices.
settings.ai.policy.movesNote: A running line moves to another choice only on a condition set below, at a part's end.
settings.ai.policy.limits.shareLabel: At most this share of new starts (%)
settings.ai.policy.limits.tokensNote: Reported tokens are what the agent reported today. A turn can pass the budget before its usage arrives: it guards the next start and is not a cap.
settings.ai.policy.moves.title: When a choice cannot go on
settings.ai.policy.when.quiet: It went quiet and was stopped
settings.ai.policy.when.budget: It is over its daily budget
settings.ai.policy.action.weighted: Move to the next by weight
settings.ai.policy.today.limit: as today: the next choice, or wait where there is one
settings.ai.policy.today.transient: as today: hold for you after five tries
settings.ai.policy.today.failed: as today: try it again until failed sessions park the quest
settings.ai.policy.today.budget: passed at a new start only
settings.ai.policy.today.signed-out: the account's move once, then the next choice
settings.ai.policy.today.model-refused: the next choice within the same start
settings.ai.policy.mostOf: Moves to another choice a day
settings.ai.policy.mostAfter: moves to another choice a day for one quest or conversation, then it waits for you.
settings.ai.policy.always: Always: a refused model or sign-in goes to the next choice; your pick and a handed agent wait; nothing moves mid-turn.
settings.ai.policy.stale: Its policy was set for other choices; it runs them in order until you save it again.
settings.ai.policy.noStore: Policies are kept in this machine's store, which this home does not use yet.
settings.ai.policy.older: An older Daoris runs these choices in order, without weights or moves.
settings.ai.policy.place.stale: its policy was set for other choices; it runs them in order until you save it again
